description:
From ISS-001, 38fd461. blocker_state.py:18,148 caps a scope at 500 paths and drops the oldest together with their pending blockers, so touching 500+ files escapes a blocker.

Fix: evict only paths without a pending blocker. If every tracked path has a blocker, keep them all and let the 7 s Stop budget report unscanned files as it already does. Update README "Budget" and CHANGELOG.

Acceptance: 501 paths with the first holding a blocker, the blocker survives and still blocks Stop; clean old paths are evicted. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Never evict a path with a pending blocker from the Stop scope
